item.title: LPM 2022 Rome, A Celebration of Audio Visual Performing Arts
item.description: The 23rd Edition of the Live Performers Meeting (LPM) The 23rd edition of the Live Performers Meeting (LPM) made a triumphant return to Rome from June 9th to 12th, 2022, at the Nuovo Cinema Aquila. As a significant gathering of artists from the AVnode network, LPM provided a unique opportunity for the public to immerse themselves in the world of Audio Visual Performing Arts.
